observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly wrapped in clear plastic film on a concrete floor.
The headlight lens is visible through the plastic, but reflections obscure fine surface detail.
No brand name, logo, or part number is visible on the item in the photo.
A watermark reading "PUREGOLD GLOBAL" appears across the center of the image.
Another plastic-wrapped item and a shoe are visible in the background.

claims.claim: Genuine Kia or Hyundai spare part, new or fairly used
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows no badge, part number, or original packaging to confirm make, model, genuineness, or condition.

risks.risk: The headlight may not fit the buyer's specific Kia or Hyundai model.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the part number or compatibility label on the housing, or a screenshot matching the part to a model and year.

risks.risk: The part may be aftermarket or counterfeit rather than genuine.
risks.proof: Photo showing an embossed brand logo and part number on the headlight housing, or original sealed manufacturer packaging.

risks.risk: The headlight may be cracked, have broken mounting points, internal moisture, or non-functional electronics.
risks.proof: Unwrapped photos from front, back, and sides, plus a video of the lights turning on.

risks.risk: The item may be fairly used rather than new despite the plastic wrapping.
risks.proof: Timestamped unboxing video or original purchase receipt.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the label or part number on the back of the headlight housing.
Unwrapped photos showing the lens condition, mounting brackets, and electrical connector.
Video of the headlight functioning with bulbs or LEDs lit.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a car headlight assembly from photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case pending proof of fitment, genuineness, and working condition.
